objective: Branding solo en Dexie: retirar la via localStorage muerta del backup/restore (9 -> 0).
dod: npx tsc -b && npx vitest run tests/brandingDexieOnlyGuard.test.ts --reporter=dot

invariant.statement: Referencias a claves localStorage de branding en src (constantes y literales): 9 -> 0.

metric.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let n=0;const st=['src'];const RE=/\bBRANDING_MODE\b|\bBRANDING_ACTIVE_SEASON\b|\bBRANDING_BIRTHDAY\b|flu-branding-mode|flu-branding-active-season|flu-branding-birthday/;while(st.length){const d=st.pop();for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())st.push(p);else if(/[.](ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs)$/.test(e.name)){for(const l of fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').split('\n'))if(RE.test(l))n++;}}}console.log(n)"
